# Prescriptive lessons — ted-greene × modern-chord-progressions

47 prescriptive lessons across 15 chord_qualities covering Greene's progression-context teaching (vs Chord Chemistry's per-chord catalog). Key vocabulary: diatonic-cycle-function, register-rule, omission-policy, raise-third-to-dom7-rule, homonym-substitution, altered-tone-voice-leading-rule, combining-consonant-dissonant-progressions, diatonic-preparation-rule, ii-for-iv-homonym.

See `prescriptive-lessons-draft.json` for the structured 47-entry payload. The PRESCRIPTIVE.md grouped synthesis includes coverage of: maj, min, maj7, min7, min7b5, dom7, dom7b9, dom7alt, dom7#9, maj6, maj69, add9, sus4, maj7#11, and the min7/11 voicing-exception rule.

(Compact form to keep PR review surface manageable; per-quality breakdown is in the JSON.)
